question: Which Union Territory of India is located in the Arabian Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lakshadweep** is the only Union Territory of India located in the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• The name "Lakshadweep" translates to "a hundred thousand islands" in Malayalam, reflecting its geographical nature as a group of 36 islands.
 
• The territory covers a total area of only **32 square kilometers**, making it the smallest Union Territory in India in terms of land area.
 
• It consists of **12 atolls, 3 reefs, and 5 submerged banks**, with 10 inhabited islands. Kavaratti is the administrative headquarters.
 
• The islands are known for their **pristine beaches, coral reefs, and unique biodiversity**, making them a hub for eco-tourism and marine conservation efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**

 
 
• Located in the **Bay of Bengal**, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are a group of 572 islands.
 
• These islands are known for their tribal population, rich biodiversity, and historical importance, such as the Cellular Jail in Port Blair.
 
• The islands are also a hub for marine biodiversity, including coral reefs and endangered species like dugongs and sea turtles.
 
 
 
• **Chandigarh**
 
 
• Chandigarh is a Union Territory that serves as the capital of two Indian states: Punjab and Haryana.
 
• It is known for its **modern architecture and urban design**, planned by Swiss-French architect Le Corbusier.
 
• Chandigarh is not located in any sea or ocean; it is an inland Union Territory in northern India.
 
 
 
• **Puducherry**
 
 
• Puducherry (formerly Pondicherry) is a Union Territory located along the southeastern coast of India, on the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• It consists of four small districts: Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam, each geographically separated.
 
• The region is known for its **French colonial heritage**, serene beaches, and unique blend of Indian and French cultures.
